worker_stage: submitting active frame stage captured alongside collector; serial submissions inherit current frame
case_snapshots: cumulative explicit begin/end markers; active_contexts and quiescent flags authoritative; nonquiescent differences are not exact per-case deltas
final_cpu_scope: existing Session destructor after task joins; cumulative exclusive native-thread CPU across caller and pool workers; includes clock-read overhead
work_scope: original native fft_work counters from active post-push snapshots plus exact destruction snapshots; final all-destroyed totals; partial execution CPU is included but interrupted jobs may not increment original completion counters; failed-constructor counters unavailable; threshold trials can roll back at EOF
pcm_scope: generated channel output before RX delivery; partitions preserve source coordinates and normal/partial read outcome; no claim every lane committed
calibration: 6 batches of10000 native thread CPU clock reads after Session joins; median cost times actual profiler clock_reads is an estimate, not a bound
overhead_limit: natural origin differs from prior runs; no matched overall overhead claim; observer subsets and clock calibration exclude trace writer and other context overhead
interpretation: diagnostic only; original512MiB fixture and120s assertions unchanged; no32MiB or application qualification

pcm_partition_fields.file_sample_offset: u64 sample offset in concatenated PCM file
pcm_partition_fields.case_sequence: u64 most recent test begin/end marker at capture
pcm_partition_fields.partial: bool original read threw after generating prefix

work_complete_semantics: all observed fully constructed native owner lifetimes closed without map/overflow/fallback omissions; not a guarantee that counters enumerate every interrupted arithmetic operation
pcm_channel_identity: one positive Session continuous channel; no configure between raw/short/framed; case/source coordinates join existing capacity_shape_channel_origin events
